title: Solar-Powered EV Charging Station, Abuja
location: Silverbird Entertainment Centre, Central Business District, Abuja
summary: A solar canopy over the Silverbird Entertainment Centre car park, with charging bays for electric vehicles beneath it.
description:
Our solar-powered electric vehicle charging station is in the car park of the Silverbird Entertainment Centre in Abuja's Central Business District. Solar panels on the canopy roof generate electricity on site, and drivers charge their electric vehicles in the shaded bays below.

The station is open to EV drivers. Contact us for charging rates and directions.
